name: University of East Anglia

facts.text: UEA was founded in 1963 with room for about 1,200 students and now has over 17,000 students.
UEA's campus is on the Norwich Research Park, near the centre of Norwich (address Norwich Research Park, Norwich, Norfolk NR4 7TJ).
The Norwich Research Park is described as a world-leading centre for environment, health and plant science research and is home to the Norfolk and Norwich University Hospital.

UEA is consistently ranked in the top 25 universities in the UK and in the UK top 20 for research quality (Times Higher Education, 2021 REF); the campus includes the Sainsbury Centre art museum and the Sportspark.
Norwich is England's first UNESCO City of Literature.
